The senator representing Kaduna South Senatorial District, Sunday Katung, has urged Hausa Christians in Kaduna North region of the state to mobilise support for the re-election of President Bola Tinubu, Governor Uba Sani and other candidates of the All Progressives Congress ahead of the 2027 general elections. Katung made the call on Thursday at a town hall meeting with the leadership of the Hausa Christian Political Youth Forum and delegates from Kaduna North Senatorial District in Zaria. Katung, while addressing the participants, said Tinubu and Uba’s administrations had demonstrated commitment to inclusive governance, fairness and justice, irrespective of religious or ethnic differences. He said, “The administration of President Tinubu and Governor Uba Sani have left no community behind. Inclusivity, fairness and justice will remain the guiding principles of the APC government.” The senator urged the youths to remain united, peaceful and politically active, describing their numerical strength as a significant factor in the party’s electoral fortunes. The era of politics of division is over. What remains is politics of development, inclusion and victory for all,” he said. He challenged the Hausa Christian community to take ownership of the party’s political campaign by mobilising voters at polling units, wards and local government areas. Speaking on behalf of the governor, Adams commended Katung for convening the meeting and appreciated the stakeholders for their support for the APC. The meeting was attended by a former governor of the state, Mukhtar Yero; the APC deputy governorship candidate, Jerry Adams; and the representative of the Speaker of the House of Representatives, Daniel Amos, among other party stakeholders. The gathering was organised to rally support for Tinubu, Uba, Yero, who is the APC senatorial candidate for Kaduna North, and other party candidates. Godwin Isenyo
